items.title: Direct 3D isolation in gelatin methacryloyl microbeads versus conventional 2D isolation and culture: a trade-off between mesenchymal stromal cell purity and niche-associated transcriptional profiles
items.finding: Across four human donors, day-21 2D plastic culture gave a purer MSC marker compartment than bulk GelMA 3D isolation, while one-donor scRNA-seq of GelMA microbead-derived cells (37,784 cells) found niche-associated MSC clusters within a heterogeneous marrow mix (4,840 DEGs vs 2D).

items.title: Osteogenic priming of canine perivascular mesenchymal stromal cells enhances extracellular vesicle yield and in vitro activity for bone regeneration
items.finding: Osteogenic priming of canine umbilical cord perivascular MSCs raised EV particle yield about 1.5-fold (5.6 +/- 0.5 x 10^10 vs 3.7 +/- 0.7 x 10^10 particles/mL) without changing size distribution or TSG101, and improved mineralization (P=0.0003) and EV-driven migration (P=0.005).

items.title: Dynamic tensile conditioning of mesenchymal stem cell-laden auxetic scaffolds for enhanced YAP-dependent miR-30 enrichment in extracellular vesicles for pulmonary fibrosis therapy
items.finding: Dynamic stretch on auxetic lung-dECM scaffolds drove YAP nuclear accumulation in MSCs and selective miR-30 enrichment in the resulting EVs; in bleomycin rats those dEVs restored lung architecture and cut collagen, with miR-30 acting on myofibroblasts and M1-to-M2 macrophage switching.

items.title: ATG5-overexpressing MSCs improve ligament healing with an associated shift toward M2 macrophage polarization in aged rats
items.finding: Aged rats healed medial collateral ligaments poorly and aged MSCs showed low autophagy; ATG5-overexpressing aged MSCs transplanted into injured ligaments were linked to better repair (proliferation, angiogenesis, collagen, biomechanics), less apoptosis, and a shift toward M2 macrophage markers.

items.title: Mesenchymal stromal cells immunosuppress osteoarthritis synovial fluid modulated monocytes via IL-6 and CCL2
items.finding: KOA synovial fluid pushed CD14+ monocytes into a dysfunctional mixed phenotype with impaired phagocytosis; marrow MSC conditioned medium restored CD163/CD206 up, HLA-DR/CD86 down, STAT3 up and JNK/NF-kB down, cut TNF and IL-1, and restored phagocytosis, with IL-6 block (and to a lesser extent CCL2) partly reversing the MSC effect.

items.title: Proteomic and beta-hydroxybutyrylation landscapes reveal AMPK-alpha2-associated modulation in HUCMSC-derived exosome-mediated amelioration of cardiac aging
items.finding: In wild-type aged mice, hUCMSC exosomes improved systolic and diastolic function, grip strength, fibrosis and ATP, with proteomics mapping 1,755 Kbhb sites on 652 proteins; AMPK-alpha2 knockout aged mice got only partial diastolic and mitochondrial rescue without systolic or fibrosis recovery.

items.title: Adhesive cationic hyaluronic acid loading with small extracellular vesicles from IL-6 activated mesenchymal stem cells improves repair of corrosive esophageal injury
items.finding: IL-6-pretreated UC-MSC small EVs outperformed naive sEVs on fibroblast migration and macrophage inflammation suppression, and when loaded in a cationic hyaluronic acid adhesive hydrogel cut inflammation, oxidative stress, fibrosis and stricture in a rat corrosive esophageal injury model.

items.title: A trial of exosome rich stem cell secretome as a potential treatment for Hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome
items.finding: In a 10-patient open-label pilot, IV bone-marrow MSC extracellular-vesicle-enriched secretome (up to four doses over up to five months) had no treatment-related adverse events; the group improved on a 9-criteria symptom score, six of ten had rapid sustained gains, and one extended-treatment responder stayed in apparent remission for 32 months after stopping.

items.title: Adipose mesenchymal stem cells secreted exosomal miR-26a-5p ameliorate renal fibrosis via inhibiting glycolysis and ferroptosis in renal interstitial fibrosis
items.source: Journal of Cellular and Molecular Medicine
items.finding: Adipose MSC exosomes cut UUO mouse renal fibrosis and suppressed tubular glycolysis and ferroptosis; miR-26a-5p was enriched in the exosomes and targeted Pfkfb3, and knocking down miR-26a-5p weakened protection while Pfkfb3 inhibition rescued the loss.

items.title: Safety and biodistribution of NK cell-based immunotherapy in healthy and cancer-bearing humanized-BLT mice
items.finding: Osteoclast- and probiotic-expanded supercharged NK (sNK) cells killed cancer cells but not primary immune cells, circulated into hu-BLT mouse tissues after adoptive transfer without visible toxicity, and raised peripheral NK percentages in the mice.

items.title: Cytokine-induced killer cells combined with temozolomide suppress glioblastoma progression in an orthotopic model and demonstrate clinical feasibility in recurrent glioblastoma
items.finding: Twelve patient-derived CIK products showed effector-memory phenotype with high NKG2D/DNAM-1; in orthotopic LN229 GBM mice TMZ and TMZ+CIK both cut radiance vs control by week 4 (treatment-by-time p=0.0054) without a clear TMZ vs TMZ+CIK gap, and in 12 recurrent GBM patients median PFS was 10.5 months and median OS 14.2 months with stable disease as best response.

items.title: Bone marrow macrophage STING signaling is a direct nexus linking marrow adipose expansion to NAD+ depletion and osteogenic decline in skeletal aging
items.finding: Age-accumulated marrow adipocyte sDPP4 activated TLR4/STING in bone marrow macrophages, driving CD38 upregulation that depleted NMN and impaired neighboring BM-MSC osteogenesis; STING inhibition plus NMN attenuated bone loss in preclinical models, while STING loss helped from mid-life but hurt early development.

items.title: Paracrine bone-derived senescent secretome is associated with spatially patterned ECM remodeling and altered biomechanics in human brain organoids
items.finding: Chronic exposure of human cerebral organoids to senescent osteocyte secretome remodeled ECM and mechanics (lower apparent modulus intact; locally elevated modulus in cryosections) and upregulated ECM/inflammatory/senescence programs while suppressing neurodevelopmental and synaptic networks.

items.title: Reprogramming NOX4-associated ferro-aging with an iron-chelating senescent-cell-targeted therapy for intervertebral disc degeneration
items.finding: A NOX4-linked ferro-aging program in nucleus pulposus cells was targeted with SenoFAN, an amentoflavone-loaded iron-chelating phenolic nanozyme coated with NKG2D-engineered NPC membranes; in a rat puncture IVDD model it preferred ferro-aging NPCs, stayed in the disc longer, cut iron and senescence, and preserved disc structure with favorable biosafety.

items.title: High-fat diet-induced metabolic stress durably reprograms the liver regenerative compartment toward a senescence-like state
items.finding: Chronic high-fat diet in male rats left a persistent senescence-like state in liver regenerative cells: after CCl4 injury proliferation was reduced, and HFD-derived liver organoids kept low formation/serial propagation, high SA-beta-gal, low Lamin B1 and Ki67 through passage 3; MitoQ partly restored formation efficiency and cut oxidative/inflammatory secretion.

items.title: Polygonatum sibiricum polysaccharide attenuates BMSC senescence by inhibiting NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy
items.finding: Polygonatum sibiricum polysaccharide concentration-dependently cut TBH-induced rat BMSC senescence, partly restored osteogenesis and reduced adipogenesis, by lowering NCOA4-driven ferritinophagy, Fe2+ load, mitochondrial ROS and cGAS-STING; NCOA4 overexpression blunted the protection.

items.title: The bile acid receptor TGR5 modulates hippocampal neural stem cell state and ageing
items.finding: TGR5 agonist TC-G 1005 expanded hippocampal NSCs without forcing neurons, released BMP4 quiescence, reopened autophagy, and cut IL-6-driven p53/p16; in 18-month-old mice 5 mg/kg SC twice daily for 28 days expanded SOX2+ and proliferating NSCs, reduced p16, improved spatial memory, and shifted 86 shared proteins toward a younger hippocampal proteome.
